Wikipedia has [[wikipedia:Robert Jordan|an article on Robert Jordan]], the pen name of James Oliver Rigney, Jr., who died September 16, 2007.

This page is for information not suited to a general encyclopedia, such as correspondence and other fan-related information.

See also: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Rigney-416 genealogical information at WikiTree].

==Searchable Database of ALL Plot-related WoT Quotes==
